text: Hi, my citizenship approval took 10 months after the interview. It was in July 2025 & I got the call for the answer & an appointment to come in and receive it in May 2026. Also, you have to allow time to receive your passport which was about 4 weeks. I just received my Israeli passport few days ago. I would suggest to request an appointment via online request for either extension of your A5 or an answer.
